title: Doric's Task VII (miniquest)
start: Speak to Doric in his hut just outside the gates of Taverley north of Falador.

recommended.t: Falador Teleport or activated Falador lodestone
Luck of the Dwarves, ring of slaying, or access to fairy rings (code DKR or DKS). Alternatively, take the mining cart from the Dwarven Mine or the Grand Exchange trapdoor.

steps.t: Speak to Doric in his hut north of Falador. [Chat: 1 Do you have any more Smithing tasks for me? › Accept]
Head to the northwesternmost building in western Keldagrim.

Talk to Santiri. [Chat: 1 Doric sent me here to make your dreams come true. › 1 I'll ask him for it now.] (If this is your first time in Keldagrim, you may need to talk to Santiri to accept an unrelated task, talk to him again to cancel it, and then talk to him a final time to start dialogue about the miniquest.)
Talk to the Supreme Commander in the building south of him up the stairs. [Chat: ? (3 or 4 depending on completed quests) I must go now.]
Use the black guard warhammer on an anvil (one is located south of the building the Supreme Commander is in).
Talk to Santiri. [Chat: 1 I have your warhammer.]
Talk to the Librarian, in the northeasternmost building in western Keldagrim. [Chat: ? (2, 3, or 4 depending on the situation) Can you tell me about first-generation black warhammers?]
Head to the Stonemason in the southernmost building in western Keldagrim. [Chat: 4 Do you know anything about crushing warhammers?]
Use the cracked warhammer on the stone crusher in the northwest corner of the building.
Talk to Santiri. [Chat: 1 I have your warhammer.]
Head to eastern Keldagrim and use the crushed warhammer on the well.
Talk to Santiri. [Chat: 1 I have your warhammer.]
